what: `git merge-base HEAD origin/all-1111` fails in a worktree cut from a fetch that left the branch in FETCH_HEAD only; the sync script's left side of a pipe failed, shipped nothing, and the test ran on the tree before.
cost: one test run read as a result of code that was not there
cause: a pipeline's status is its last command's; the script had no `pipefail`
workaround: the base is written out; errors of the sync are printed
